notes.title: V1.6 - New Levels, Bikes & Languages!
notes.content:
V1.6 is now live with the following main features:


 "The Zone" 4 new special stage levels mini chapter (we may have got carried away with these)
 3 new bikes including Pinkbike's "Grim Donut"
 Optional Controller Vibration
 Improved bike customisation
 You can now go straight to Customise from in-game without flicking through to the main menu
 Options for German / French / Portugese & Spanish localisation
 Minor bug fixes and level design tweaks


As always we've tested this update as much as we can, if you notice anything wrong let us know and we will sort it as fast as we can

Enjoy!

notes.title: v1.58 Now live
notes.content:
v1.58 Changes

General


 Added V sync and framerate limiting options.
 Improved support for PS4 controllers
 Loads of smaller environment art tweaks
 Level design tweaks, "Containable" is pretty sweet now!
 Improved rider animation


Bikes


 Added stats display to show bike properties
 Balanced Bike properties and handling for better gameplay
 Added new ASBO FR hardtail bike


Achievements


 Fixed broken Man Of Steel Achievement
 Added 3 new achivements


Think thats most things off the top of my head - shoot us an email if you find anything wrong and we'll get on it!

Cheers

Alex & Dave

notes.title: v1.56 Now Live
notes.content:
v1.56 Now Live


 Improved animation and new Sam Pilgrim character look, with official TSG helmet branding.
 Improved Terrain shading.
 Several level design, challenges and environment art improvements
 Minor bike aesthetic changes
 Probably other stuff I've forgotten!


We are a mega small team, its just me Alex, and sometimes Dave too. There is always a chance weve missed somthing in testing, please let us know if you find the update has broken anything and well get on it ASAP!

Quickest way is to email, or hit me up on discord, id: erniesbot

Enjoy
